scope: No application source changed during the thirty-case run.
tabFailures: Two cases used an exact accessible tab name omitting its actual event count; action was not reached.
backFailures: Two cases assumed Home returned to the original run, but the current run is the first option. The old response was not released, so the intended context assertion was not reached.
supersededFailures: Two cases did not establish the desired newer selection with End/Enter before requesting its snapshot. This precondition needs isolation; no superseding-read outcome was exercised.
missingAuthoredFailures: Two cases observed the unavailable option and hint, but isDisabled() returned false. Retained accessibility context explicitly reports the option disabled; verify its native disabled attribute and keyboard behavior instead of inferring from helper retargeting.
